product.summary: Current non-custodial Talisman browser-extension wallet for supported Polkadot, Ethereum and related networks.
product.notes: Current first-party installation documentation supports Chrome, Firefox, Brave and Edge. Initial extension launch date remains unresolved. First-party Talisman release notes identify v1.0.0 on 2022-03-03 as the first public wallet release.

events.title: Talisman Wallet Extension v1.0.0 publicly released
events.description: Talisman official wallet release notes identify v1.0.0 on 2022-03-03 as the first public release of the wallet extension, documenting account creation/import, Polkadot and Kusama transaction signing, asset viewing and sending, dapp account authorization, address copying, and seed/JSON export.

evidence.title: Download the extension
evidence.notes: Current first-party installation guide establishes Talisman Extension distribution for Chrome, Firefox, Brave and Edge.

evidence.title: Download the Extension
evidence.notes: Current first-party Talisman documentation distributes the extension for Chrome, Firefox, Brave and Edge and documents current setup, supporting active maintenance.

evidence.title: Wallet Release Notes
evidence.notes: First-party Talisman release notes explicitly call v1.0.0 on 2022-03-03 the first public release of the wallet.
